ruleDefinitions.name: Shell Invocation Via Ssh - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of the "ssh" utility to execute a shell. Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/ssh$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*ProxyCommand\\=\\;.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*permitlocalcommand\\=yes.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*localhost.*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/bash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/dash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/fish.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/zsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*sh\\ 0\\<\\&2\\ 1\\>\\&2.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*sh\\ 1\\>\\&2\\ 0\\<\\&2.*")))
